provenance: SN-distributed GNUPro/SCE source; Wayback ps2dev.sourceforge.net ee/gnu-ee-binutils-gcc-1.1.tar.gz (sha256 1f518043e252d6eda726386971d52eda26541ab936ea73a9783d73712b595f92)
role: Sibling-call expansion is OFF by default (retail behavior); -mastra-sibcall re-enables it per unit.
mechanism: P15's opt-in -mastra-no-sibcall gate becomes the default: calls.c suppresses sibling calls unless mips_astra_sibcall is set. Evidence: across the 547 measurable promoted sources the default flip converts 37 units and regresses only 6, all of which are genuine retail tail-call idioms (`j _ipuSetMPEG1`, `j` to a callee). In the wider 557-source sample exactness rises 196 -> 231.

control_parity.note: joint gate unchanged; rows for the five gate units no longer need the flag

wide_sample.note: the six regressions are retail tail-call idioms and stay exact with -mastra-sibcall (SDK-line units on their own route)
